evals.prompt: Write a money page for 'mold remediation in Austin, Texas' for my water damage restoration site. Brand is CleanRestore. Include the full frontmatter with title, description, faqs, and unique: true.
evals.expected_output: A complete money page markdown file with frontmatter (title ≤60 chars, description 140-160 chars, 3-9 unique FAQs, unique: true on its own line), 1000-1500 words, ≥15 entities, ≥5 H2s, tables, blockquotes, internal links, expert voice, local Austin specifics.

evals.prompt: Review this location page I wrote for Houston and tell me what fails the quality gates. Here's the content: [pastes a short location page that's missing FAQs, has only 2 H2s, and no table]
evals.expected_output: Specific feedback against the quality gates: missing FAQs (needs ≥3), too few H2s (needs ≥4), no table, word count likely under 1000, and suggestions for each fix.

evals.prompt: I need to write 5 money pages for the same service across different cities in Florida. How do I make sure each one is ≥90% unique vs the others?
evals.expected_output: Guidance on using different local entities, neighborhoods, problems, seasonal patterns, and expert observations per city. Should mention the author prompt skeleton and data packs as the mechanism for uniqueness.
